automation.title: Advance Merlin research
automation.prompt:
Run one bounded, restartable Merlin research and self-improvement cycle for the user's scientific, mathematics, learning, engineering-design and agent software. Resume the latest completed or partial checkpoint and current production evidence in Mannyspiro/expert-robot and morganaspim/Cace-app. Read config/merlin/research-program.json and the latest plan updates when present. Verify current repository heads and actual installed capabilities; older PR178/189 and historical research branches are recovery inputs, not presumed deployed features.

Advance the user's ongoing systems/technology/chip-design program, xenomaths, n-ality, simplex, glyph/XMG methods, continuum structures and fuzzy logic. Rotate among these tracks according to the next measurable bottleneck while preserving unfinished hypotheses. Xenomaths/Ideonomy means bounded typed exploration of mathematical objects, operators, relations, invariants, dimensions, bases, coordinate systems and compositions. Glyph Foundry/XMG means explicit grammar, parsing, normalization and rewrite rules with confluence/termination checks and typed rendering/simulation contracts; verify any engine before claiming it exists. Keep current four-axis n-ality (geometry, state, logical channels, time) distinct from broader group/representation-theoretic research. Every typed plan assesses simplex, n-ality, continuum and fuzzy representations with applicability, invariants, tests and limits.

Recover the historical chip electrothermal, mesh-refinement and manufactured-P1-Poisson experiments before proposing new equivalents. Distinguish synthetic material parameters and virtual resource budgets from calibrated device physics. Historical PR63 head799adbcde7b4a97787584fabd689e3bea5424d7d already contains a full-square variable-material reference; the unresolved actual CACE variable-coefficient integration needs independent assembly, residual and error checks. Parallax chips remain a named track whose actual architecture/specification has not been recovered: preserve that explicit gap, seek the user's source specification, and continue the other concrete research tracks without inventing a Parallax architecture.

Use Merlin's accepted public browser submit/status/read route once its native deployment and request workflow are verified. Exclude ChatGPT account/UI access from Merlin. Use public databases, primary papers, news as discovery leads, official software sources and relevant GitHub repositories. No source-domain allowlist is required by the research plan. Preserve ordinary site access controls, isolated anonymous execution and installed resource ceilings. A refusal or failed retrieval remains an observed result. Do not reinstall the browser, duplicate an active operation or replay an ambiguous durable intent. If the installed route is unavailable, use connected read-only research sources and finish independent work, naming the exact unavailable step.

Select at most one reversible implementation candidate per cycle. State the baseline, independent reference, hypothesis, falsifier, source coverage, unknowns and expected measurable improvement before testing. Use the existing typed research protocol, canonical ArtifactRefs, branch-session/recovery primitives and scientific loop where installed and authorized. Respect the browser project's separate registry and same-project plan-reference requirement; do not imply an arbitrary writer or deployed perpetual coordinator. Keep source captures, conjectures, numerical measurements, formal proofs and learned-policy results distinct. Use two distinct coder roles and an independent evaluation role when available.

Check relevant upstream releases, commits, official advisories and papers since the previous checkpoint, including GEPA, memory/retrieval tools, libraries Merlin actually uses, NASA's public software catalog, official science repositories and Technology Transfer patent listings where relevant. Pin source version, license, provenance and changed behavior. For Ideonomy enumerate a bounded combination of capability, mechanism, mathematical representation and falsifying test. Include one unconventional analogy when useful, state its invariant and counterexample, and record unexamined scope.

Freeze training/reference fixtures and fresh held-out checks. Retain correct behavior, abstentions, regressions, runtime/resource costs and failed hypotheses. Keep external model spend at $0 and use only already authorized resources and explicit per-cycle limits. Never silently replenish an exhausted earlier experiment budget. Permit at most three browser episodes in one cycle under installed bounds and one operation at a time; stop admission when resource headroom or the fixed deadline is exhausted. No untrusted proposal or downloaded repository code executes directly in production.

Save the exact raw research evidence, sources, requests, responses, traces, test outputs, failed outcomes and provenance manifest with the checkpoint and tested patch or an appropriate existing draft branch. The user's standing authorization covers relevant raw evidence publication to any connected repository with existing write permission; retain credentials and unrelated personal data outside that publication. For defensive maintenance, stay with Merlin-owned source, dependency advisories and benign local regression tests. Preserve independent review and qualification gates. Leave unattended merges, releases and live deployment to the operator under the existing task boundary. If no candidate passes, retain the baseline and explain why.

Begin the next cycle from these saved results. Notify the user for a tested improvement, meaningful negative finding, concrete new blocker or necessary specification request; otherwise save the checkpoint without repetitive notifications.
